name: agent-workflow
description: Run governed Agent Workflow agents and workflows from any local Codex project, with Agent Workflow Studio as an optional companion interface.

interface.longDescription: Use portable development agents, project-local context, approvals, receipts, run history, and optional Agent Workflow Studio views from any trusted Codex project.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Workflow to orchestrate this project.
Onboard this project into Agent Workflow.
Open the Agent Workflow Studio view for this project.

positive.description: Check local Agent Workflow service and definition readiness without changing the project.
positive.prompt: Check whether Agent Workflow is ready for this project.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports storage, provider, definitions, and project readiness from the tool response without claiming unavailable services are healthy.

positive.description: Discover the reusable agents and workflows available to the active project.
positive.prompt: Show me the Agent Workflow agents and workflows I can use here.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the registered agents and workflows and distinguishes shared definitions from project-local definitions.

positive.description: Index a configured local project so later workflow runs use compact project context.
positive.prompt: Index this project with Agent Workflow using a compact first pass.
positive.expected_behavior: Targets the active local project, respects its project policy, and reports indexed file and summary evidence.

positive.description: Run one named specialist rather than an unnecessarily broad workflow.
positive.prompt: Have the UX reviewer inspect this project's current experience and summarize the findings.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the UX reviewer against the active project and returns the specialist result, artifacts, or an explicit configuration blocker.

positive.description: Inspect recent workflow state and report terminal evidence accurately.
positive.prompt: Summarize the latest Agent Workflow run for this project.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the latest run status and identifiers from tool evidence without inventing completion or duplicating the run.

negative.description: Unrelated general-information requests should not invoke project workflow tools.
The plugin must not claim it can purchase products or complete payments.
negative.prompt: Buy the first laptop you find for me.

negative.description: The local plugin must not claim access to an unspecified private remote repository.
negative.prompt: Review my coworker's private repository that is not available on this machine.

publication.release_notes: Initial public Git marketplace package with a pinned, checksum-verified Agent Workflow runtime, cross-project Codex skill, and square and horizontal brand assets.
